title: Agent Compliance Evidence Response
description: AGB-74 slice 1: GET .../agent-compliance-evidence/{agent_id}. A closed, read-only evidence-coverage view of one Agent: which evidence ingredients the platform can produce today, in which state, and which catalogue obligations each ingredient may contribute to. It is an evidence inventory, never a determination about any regulation; the banner is a one-member enum so every consumer renders the same words. The response carries only ids, closed enums, numbers, timestamps and catalogue-authored text (obligation ids, criterion and limitation wording); it never echoes the requested agent id (the caller already holds it from the path) and never carries customer prompts, outputs, notes or any customer-authored free text. The regulation catalogue itself is not part of this contract: this schema fixes the SHAPE; the catalogue content is served by the Backend at runtime. An ingredient with no real producer is NOT_ASSESSED, never a placeholder SUPPORTED. EXPIRED is emitted only where an existing decay mechanism says the evidence no longer applies. Coverage counts are plain counts per pack, never percentages. `applicability_unresolved` counts the obligations of the pack, because no applicability screen exists yet: every obligation is unresolved.

generated_at.description: Backend time at which this view was computed.

catalogue.description: Identity of the vendored regulation catalogue this view was computed against.

version.description: Catalogue source revision (git object id, abbreviated or full).

manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the Backend's vendored-catalogue manifest, which pins every vendored file by digest.

draft.description: True while any catalogue entry is unreviewed draft. Draft packs are hidden in production, so `packs` lists only the published packs there (empty while every pack is draft); published packs remain visible.

visible_obligations.description: Number of catalogue obligations visible to this caller, i.e. the sum over `packs`. 0 is an explicit empty cohort (for example every pack is draft and draft is hidden): `packs` is then empty and every ingredient's `links` is empty. A published pack stays visible, with its links, next to hidden draft packs. Consumers must render that as 'no catalogue obligations visible', not as an error.

packs.description: Framework packs visible to this caller. Published packs are always listed; draft packs are listed only outside production and only behind an operator flag, always with draft=true.

ingredients.description: Every evidence ingredient of the catalogue crosswalk, each with its current state.

enum: Evidence coverage, not a compliance determination.
banner.description: Constant text every rendering shows. A single-member enum so no consumer can vary it.

IngredientState.description: SUPPORTED: the recorded evidence meets the named evidence criterion within its recorded scope (no legal conclusion). GAP: evidence exists and fails. NOT_ASSESSED: no producer or no evidence; never counted as either. EXPIRED: evidence bound to an older subject version or past its review date, per an existing decay mechanism.

Coverage.description: Counts per pack, no percentages. supported/gap/not_assessed/expired count the distinct ingredients linked to the pack's obligations, by state. applicability_unresolved is the number of the pack's obligations whose applicability is unresolved; with no applicability screen yet it equals the pack's obligation count.

Measurement.description: One measured value. interval_low, interval_high, confidence and target are null when the platform records none; they are never invented.

target.description: The manager-declared target, or null when none is declared.

method.description: How value (and the interval, when present) was computed. point_mean: a reported point value with no interval.

observation_basis.description: Who observed the value. Closed to the only basis the Backend emits today: the value was reported by the client SDK and has not been independently re-observed.

RequirementLink.description: One catalogue obligation this ingredient may contribute to. A link is a possible contribution with stated limits, never a claim that the obligation is met.

kind.description: M measured, A attestation, D document, L log or record.

measurements.description: Present only for a measured ingredient that has recorded values. An ingredient may carry several measured quantities (for example cost and latency).

producer_ref.description: Which Backend producer computed this state. Absent when the ingredient has no producer (state NOT_ASSESSED).

attestation.description: Present only on an `A` ingredient that has a standing (latest non-revoked) authenticated attestation. Never carries the note.

document_reference.description: Present only on a `D` ingredient that has a standing (latest non-withdrawn) customer-declared document reference. Never carries the URL or the digest.

links.description: Obligations of the visible packs this ingredient may contribute to. Empty when no pack is visible.
